tiktok.caption: Your car dealer pocketed $4,824 from your lender the day you drove home — and it's completely legal. Here's how to stop it.

youtube_short.title: Your Car Dealer Got a $4,824 Kickback on Your Loan
title_alternatives: The Hidden Car Loan Markup Dealers Never Mention
How Dealers Secretly Make $4,800 Off Your Car Loan
youtube_short.description: When you finance a car through the dealership, they mark up your interest rate and pocket the difference — it's called dealer reserve, and it's 100% legal. On a $35,000 car with a 2.5% markup over five years, that's $4,824 straight out of your pocket. 85% of new cars are dealer-financed, so Americans hand over an estimated $14 billion in hidden markups every single year. The fix is simple: get pre-approved at a credit union first — they average 1.9% lower than dealer rates — then walk in and let the dealer beat it. They usually can't. #carbuying #finance #moneytips #personalfinance #carloan

hook_line: Your dealer got a $4,824 kickback on your loan
